description: This Java class 'DistPubSubAccess' provides static helper methods for interacting with Akka's DistributedPubSubMediator, including publishing, subscribing, unsubscribing, and message routing within a distributed pub/sub system.

classes.name: DistPubSubAccess
classes.description: Helper class for accessing Akka's DistributedPubSubMediator messages, providing static methods for publishing, subscribing, and message routing.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Creates a publish message for a given topic and message.

methods.name: publishViaGroup
methods.description: Creates a publish message to a group topic with a specific suffix.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscribe message for a specific topic and ActorRef.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Creates an unsubscribe message for a specific topic and ActorRef.

methods.name: subscribeViaGroup
methods.description: Creates a subscribe message for a group topic with a suffix.

methods.name: unsubscribeViaGroup
methods.description: Creates an unsubscribe message for a group topic with a suffix.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Registers an ActorRef on the pub/sub system.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific ActorRef path.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific ActorRef path with local affinity preference.

methods.name: sendToAll
methods.description: Sends a message to all ActorRefs at a given path.

methods.name: sendToAll
methods.description: Sends a message to all ActorRefs at a path, with option to exclude self.
